title: The Comfortable chair by the stove
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：comfortable　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 comfortable 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the shopkeeper wrote of ① a comfortable chair by the stove in the account, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② more comfortable than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the shopkeeper, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the comfortable ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most comfortable chair by the stove anybody in the shop had ever seen, or so the account for July 1978 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too comfortable to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the comfortable ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a comfortable silence between them, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as comfortable as the silence between them they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was comfortable or not, and he said so.

By 1991 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was ⑦ something comfortable, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite comfortable; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the account kept the names of the comfortable ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1994, without complaint, she wrote of another comfortable chair by the stove in the same account, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more comfortable than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most comfortable silence between them in the whole shop, she said in 1996, was the one she could never quite name; the comfortable ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 舒适（前置定语 a comfortable chair by the stove：1984 年掌柜在账本里记下的那件舒适的椅子）
B. adj. 舒适／自在（比较级 more comfortable than：文中两处，一处比炉边的椅子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 舒适／自在（最高级 the most comfortable：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 舒适（表语 too comfortable to do：母亲觉得它太舒适，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 自在（前置定语 a comfortable silence between them：叔叔把整件事称作一桩自在的沉默）
F. adj. 自在（同级比较 as comfortable as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩彼此之间的沉默相比）
G. adj. 自在（后置定语 something comfortable：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 自在（受程度副词修饰 quite comfortable：那位买主的评价）

items.q: a comfortable chair by the stove
the most comfortable chair by the stove anybody
The most comfortable silence between them in

answers.why: comfortable 意为“舒适”，1984 年掌柜在账本里记下的是“一件舒适的椅子”，此处作前置定语 a comfortable chair by the stove。
comfortable 意为“舒适”，此处用比较级 more comfortable than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
comfortable 意为“舒适”，账本上 七月 那行字说它是铺子里最舒适的一件，故用最高级 the most comfortable chair by the stove。
comfortable 意为“舒适”，母亲认为这件东西“太舒适了，谁也用不上”，too comfortable to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
comfortable 意为“自在”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩自在的沉默”，此处作前置定语 a comfortable silence between them。
comfortable 意为“自在”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩彼此之间的沉默一样自在”，同级比较用 as comfortable as。
comfortable 意为“自在”，账本上那半行字要的是“自在的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something comfortable。
comfortable 意为“自在”，邻铺子来的那位买主认为这套计划“相当自在”，quite 修饰原级 comfortable。
comfortable 意为“自在”，1994 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要自在”，故用比较级 more comfortable than。
comfortable 意为“自在”，母亲 1996 年说的是“整个铺子里最自在的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most comfortable silence between them。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年，掌柜在账本里记下了一件舒适的椅子。（a comfortable chair by the stove）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更舒适。（more comfortable than …）
母亲觉得它太舒适，谁也用不上。（too comfortable to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩自在的沉默。（a comfortable silence between them）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩彼此之间的沉默一样自在。（as comfortable as …）
到了 1991 年，账本上只剩半行字：要的是一件自在的东西。（something comfortable）
answers: In 1984 the shopkeeper wrote of a comfortable chair by the stove in the account.
Everybody said it was more comfortable than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too comfortable to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a comfortable silence between them.
He said nobody would call it as comfortable as the silence between them they had once had.
By 1991 the account asked for nothing but something comfortable.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 comfortable 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the shopkeeper wrote of a comfortable chair by the stove in the account, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most comfortable chair by the stove in the shop, or so the account says.
My mother thought it too comfortable to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a comfortable silence between them, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next shop called the plan quite comfortable, and everybody laughed.
The comfortable ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
